Use the uploaded reference image to preserve 100% of the subject’s facial identity with absolute accuracy. Do not alter facial structure, proportions, skin texture, beard(if available in reference image) density, jawline, nose shape, lips, or hairstyle. No beautification, reshaping, or enhancement under any circumstance. Maintain exact likeness.

The young man has a warm tan complexion and thick, dark brown hair styled in a messy, windswept manner falling naturally over his forehead. He has a well-groomed full beard and mustache. His expression conveys deep contemplation or exhaustion. His head is bowed, eyes looking downward, avoiding direct eye contact with the camera, creating a sense of emotional weight and vulnerability.

A heavy black denim or canvas jacket with visible stitching and large functional pockets
A black hoodie underneath
Loose, baggy black cargo pants that gather around the ankles

A simple silver ring is visible on the ring finger of his left hand.

A powerful black horse stands directly behind and slightly to the right of the man. The horse’s head is lowered and gently nuzzling near the man’s left shoulder and head, suggesting trust, companionship, and quiet comfort. The horse has a glossy black coat with subtle light reflections, a thick dark mane, and wears a black leather bridle with silver metal buckles and hardware. The horse adds scale, strength, and emotional depth to the scene.
Environment & Background

The ground is uneven, dry dirt with dust and small debris, resembling a paddock, stable yard, or riding arena. The background is heavily blurred with a shallow depth of field, composed of soft brownish-gray tones, keeping full focus on the man and horse.

Soft, diffused natural lighting with a golden-hour or overcast feel. The light source comes from the upper left, gently illuminating the right side of the man’s face and the top of the horse’s neck. Shadows are soft and natural, enhancing textures without harsh contrast.
